body_markdown:
New York is getting a Halloween double bill: on October 31,


[Harry Styles](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6KImCVD70vtIoJWnq6nGn3) ’ final night at Madison Square Garden will be paired with an electric disco dance party for fans across the city.


As he takes the stage for the last show of his 30-night residency, fans can celebrate with


**Spotify Presents: Harryween** , a one-night-only event curated by Harry in collaboration with Spotify and Despacio.


Inspired by the dance floors and underground sounds that helped shape


[Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally.](https://open.spotify.com/album/69BqE1V8Bzb9GCyeP1fFeR) , the event brings Despacio—the legendary sound system created by


**James Murphy** of


[LCD Soundsystem](https://open.spotify.com/artist/066X20Nz7iquqkkCW6Jxy6) and


**David** and


**Stephen Dewaele** of


[Soulwax](https://open.spotify.com/artist/43mWhBXSflupNLuNjM5vff) and


[2manydjs](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5bppICntghQ2YaiMPjk8l3) —to New York City for the first time in nearly a decade.


“Despacio is a one-of-a-kind sound system made by music lovers for music lovers,” said Harry. “I’m so grateful they’ve invited us in.”


While Harry will not be in attendance, top fans on Spotify received early invitations to RSVP. Public RSVPs are now open[here](http://link.dice.fm/harryween) ; RSVP and entry to the event are on a first-come, first-served basis, capped at venue capacity, and does not guarantee admission into the event.


“We’ve loved working with Harry and his team to bring this idea to life,” said


**Ashley Graver** , Spotify’s Head of Global Artist Partnerships. “What makes Harryween so special is the opportunity to extend this moment beyond the stage and give fans a completely different way to experience the music. Bringing Despacio into the mix makes it all the more exciting, and we’re thrilled to be part of it.”


## **The details**


-


- **When:** Saturday, October 31, 6–9:30 p.m. ET


- **Where:** New York City; the location will be shared closer to the date


- **How to RSVP:**[Click here](http://link.dice.fm/harryween)
